source_scope: Restored published six-donor RP1-14 inputs only; no mixed-cohort files
historical_mapping_repair: Reattach saved assignment vectors to source top-translated rows starting with C; require exact prefix, length, matrix and repeated-sequence checks
fixed_reuse_universe: Union of existing historical amino-acid CDR3 assignments, applied unchanged to full productive source counts in every visit; no new RFU assignment
gene_grouping: source_gene_calls; explicitly marked family/unresolved categories when gene unavailable
sampling_interpretation: Observed-read subsampling without replacement, conditional on historical selection; not cell/template sampling or donor uncertainty
